propositions: The rebar metrics command and registry are shipped but not consulted by rebar-janitor or referenced in canonical project documentation, making them a dead-end artifact.

rebar-janitor Discovery phase should consult `rebar metrics --since/--until --output json` to cite registered code-health-lens metric values (module-size distribution, oversized-module count, module-size trend vs 800-line cap, churn, refactor-to-addition ratio, cap-change events) as durable historical evidence.

Project documentation must include a discoverable Metrics section explaining what the four lenses (agent_process, code_health, delivery, gate_economics) surface, the source/confidence labels, and the unavailable state (reason and accruing_since).
The rebar.metrics subsystem (MetricSpec, REGISTRY, is_authoritative helper) must be documented as a reusable surface for library consumers.
AGENTS.md must include a metrics pointer in its Where to read section linking to docs/user-guide.md and docs/reuse-surface.md.
